mechanism_fidelity.rationale: Competing changes and workload variation form the differential; discriminating replay and rollback/reintroduction supply evidence; candidate-indexed support, conflict and unresolved observations revise the plausible set. The matrix adds no evidential warrant. Limits concerning confounding, incomplete explanations and replay representativeness retain the relevant constraints on attribution.

target_fidelity.rationale: Controlled comparisons of independently switchable changes under restored workload can distinguish change contributions from load variation within the stipulated replay regime. Retaining supported contributions and unresolved alternatives is an explicitly bounded contribution to the original attribution question.

operational_coherence.rationale: The available replay and rollback/reintroduction operations produce latency and workload observations that can support or contradict candidate contributions. Recurrence checks strengthen bounded attribution, while unresolved cells remain unresolved and table completeness supplies no additional evidence.

validity.rationale: The mapping preserves differential diagnosis as evidence-based revision of competing explanations and applies it coherently to bounded regression attribution without changing the target question.

uncertainty: The packet supplies no candidate-specific test outcomes, so it does not establish which deployed change contributed.
Replay findings do not establish a unique root cause or generality under live workload.
